args.title: Improve toast notification accessibility and timing for errors
args.body:
File: src/components/Toast.tsx

Change the toast notifications to treat error messages differently by removing the 5-second automatic dismissal for errors and ensuring aria-live announcements are immediate and polite. This addresses the issue where error toasts vanish too quickly and are announced too slowly.

file: src/components/Toast.tsx
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The toast notifications in src/components/Toast.tsx use a polite aria-live attribute and automatically dismiss after 5 seconds, including for error toasts. This causes error messages to be announced too slowly and disappear too quickly, which the issue correctly identifies as a problem.
